title: Unified OTJ learning timeline
details: College, learner, assessor and employer OTJ now appear together in one Recent learning timeline in date order
Learner input uses light yellow tiles, college sessions light green, assessor OTJ light blue and employer session OTJ light orange
Symi college learning no longer appears in a separate Recent college learning section
Monthly OTJ PDFs include every OTJ source for that month when the learner creates the portfolio upload package
College attendance percentages are capped at 100%
summary: Evia v239 combines every OTJ source into one colour-coded chronological learning feed and includes the combined records in monthly portfolio OTJ PDFs.
